name: Claude-Code-Game-Studios
description: Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio — 49 AI agents, 72 workflow skills, and a complete coordination system mirroring real studio hierarchy.
one_liner: Turns a single Claude Code AI assistant into a whole simulated game-development studio: 49 specialist AI 'employees' and dozens of workflows that coordinate like a real studio's departments.
buyer: A solo indie game developer who can't afford to hire artists, designers, and QA testers but wants a structured, studio-like process instead of working alone and unstructured.
business_use_cases: A solo indie dev uses it to simulate having a full art, design, and QA team to actually finish a game they'd otherwise abandon alone.
A small 2-3 person studio adopts the coordination system to divide work between humans and AI agents without inventing their own process from scratch.
A game-dev educator builds a course teaching students how a real studio pipeline works, using this as the hands-on simulation.

money_ideas.idea: Paid 'studio-in-a-box' templates for specific genres (platformer, roguelike, visual novel) pre-tuned for this system.
A Discord community or coaching service helping indie devs actually finish games using the workflow.

steal_this: Pick one of the included QA or playtesting agents, package it standalone with a short tutorial, and sell it to the large solo-gamedev audience this weekend.
